## GEOGRAPHY points and the functions over them
# Sources: BigQuery's geography_functions descriptions and examples of ST_X, ST_INTERSECTSBOX,
# ST_AZIMUTH, ST_GEOMETRYTYPE, ST_ISCLOSED, ST_GEOHASH and S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT; the st_distance
# example of BigQuery DataFrames, rounded as it prints them; and BigQuery's answers to unverified
# cases.

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 10)
=> "POINT(10 10)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(170, 10)
=> "POINT(170 10)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(5, 6)
=> "POINT(5 6)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(i, i + 1) FROM UNNEST([12]) AS i
=> "POINT(12 13)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62)
=> "POINT(-122.35 47.62)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(0.0000001, 0)
=> "POINT(1e-07 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(-0.0, 0)
=> "POINT(0 0)"

# WKT writes 15 significant digits.
SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(0.1 + 0.2, 0)
=> "POINT(0.3 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(0.0001, 0)
=> "POINT(0.0001 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 90)
=> "POINT(10 90)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(NULL, 0)
=> null

# The longitude is taken modulo 360 into [-180, 180].
SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(190, 10)
=> "POINT(-170 10)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0)
=> "POINT(180 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(-180, 0)
=> "POINT(-180 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(540, 0)
=> "POINT(-180 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90.5)
=> error: ST_GeogPoint failed: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees. Actual value was 90.5; check if longitude and latitude arguments order is correct

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64), 0)
=> error: ST_GeogPoint failed: Value of longitude cannot be NaN

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64), 0)
=> error: ST_GeogPoint failed: Value of longitude cannot be +-inf

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(0, CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_GeogPoint failed: Value of latitude cannot be NaN

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(0, CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_GeogPoint failed: Value of latitude cannot be +-inf

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64), 100)
=> error: ST_GeogPoint failed: Value of longitude cannot be +-inf

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62))
=> "POINT(-122.35 47.62)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.0000001, 0))
=> "POINT(1e-07 0)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "4.71238898038469"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

# REST spells a whole FLOAT64 with a fractional part.
SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90))
=> "0.0"

# Identical and antipodal points have no azimuth; points only nearly antipodal have one.
SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(-180, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 90))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(-30, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(150, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), ST_GEOGPOINT(-170, -20))
=> "4.71238898038469"

# From a pole, the azimuth follows the difference of the longitudes.
SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, -90), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, -90), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 0))
=> "0.17453292519943295"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(10, -90), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "6.1086523819801535"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 0))
=> "2.9670597283903604"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, -90))
=> "3.141592653589793"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, -90))
=> "3.141592653589793"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.00001, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0.00001, 0))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ROUND(ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.00003, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0.00001, 0)), 6)
=> "2.223902"

SELECT ROUND(ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.00005, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0.00001, 0)), 6)
=> "4.447804"

# Distances are measured through the chord, and REST writes a FLOAT64 from 1e7 with an exponent.
SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> "111195.10117748393"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62), ST_GEOGPOINT(139.69, 35.69))
=> "7694475.565758298"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0))
=> "2.001511821194711E7"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), FALSE)
=> "111195.10117748393"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGPOINT(i, i + 1)) FROM UNNEST([0]) AS i
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_Y(ST_GEOGPOINT(i, i + 1)) FROM UNNEST([12]) AS i
=> "13.0"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "ST_Point"

SELECT ST_DIMENSION(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "0"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "1"

SELECT ST_NPOINTS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "1"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISCOLLECTION(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(ST_GEOGPOINT(5, 0))
=> "true"

# Points have no length, area or perimeter.
SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62), 10)
=> "c22yzugqw7"

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122, 47))
=> "6093613931972369317"

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122, 47), level => 10)
=> "6093613287902019584"

# BigQuery's answers to unverified cases.

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.1 + 0.2, 0))
=> "0.30000000000000004"

# A stored GEOGRAPHY keeps its coordinates beyond the 15 significant digits of its WKT.
CREATE TEMP TABLE points AS SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(0.1 + 0.2, 0) AS g; SELECT ST_X(g) FROM points
=> "0.30000000000000004"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.1 + 0.2, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0.3, 0))
=> "5.525970306341499E-12"

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62))
=> "-122.35"

SELECT ST_Y(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62))
=> "47.62"

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGPOINT(190, 10))
=> "-170.0"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2)')
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(' point ( 1  2 ) ')
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1e1 2)')
=> "POINT(10 2)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(190 10)')
=> "POINT(-170 10)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 91)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees. Actual value was 91

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2 3)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected ')', but saw '3' at position 10.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected latitude, but saw ')' at position 7.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Unexpected end of data at position 0.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('{"type": "Point", "coordinates": [1, 2]}')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Unexpected '{' at position 0.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Unexpected '0101000000000000000000' at position 0.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINTFROMGEOHASH('c22yzugqw7')
=> "POINT(-122.349999547005 47.6200005412102)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINTFROMGEOHASH('C22YZUGQW7')
=> "POINT(-122.349999547005 47.6200005412102)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINTFROMGEOHASH('s')
=> "POINT(22.5 22.5)"

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINTFROMGEOHASH('')
=> error: ST_GeogPointFromGeoHash failed: Invalid geohash ''.

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINTFROMGEOHASH('a')
=> error: ST_GeogPointFromGeoHash failed: Invalid geohash 'a'.

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62))
=> "c22yzugqw77sv0wn5dq6"

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62), 0)
=> "c22yzugqw77sv0wn5dq6"

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62), 21)
=> "c22yzugqw77sv0wn5dq6"

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 90), 5)
=> "zzzzz"

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122, 47), level => 0)
=> "5764607523034234880"

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122, 47), level => 31)
=> error: S2_CellIdFromPoint: S2CellIdFromPoint failed: level argument must be in range [0,30], got 31

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122, 47), level => -1)
=> error: S2_CellIdFromPoint: S2CellIdFromPoint failed: level argument must be in range [0,30], got -1

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122, 47), level => NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "{ \"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [1, 2] } "

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.35, 47.62))
=> "{ \"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [-122.35, 47.62] } "

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.0000001, 0))
=> "{ \"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [1e-07, 0] } "

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 3))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(-180, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 90))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), 111196)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), 111195)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), 111195.10117748393)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), 0)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), -1)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), 1, TRUE)
=> error: ST_DWITHIN does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> "111195.10117748393"

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), TRUE)
=> error: ST_MAXDISTANCE does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), TRUE)
=> error: ST_LENGTH does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(a b)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected longitude, but saw 'a' at position 6.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT 1 2')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected '(' or EMPTY, but saw '1' at position 6.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected ')', but saw end of data at position 9.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2) x')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected end of data, but saw 'x' at position 11.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(nan 0)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected longitude, but saw 'nan' at position 6.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 -91)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees. Actual value was -91

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0.1 0.2)')
=> "POINT(0.1 0.2)"

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0.30000000000000004 0)'))
=> "0.30000000000000004"

SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), TRUE)
=> error: ST_AREA does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), TRUE)
=> error: ST_PERIMETER does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_GEOGPOINTFROMGEOHASH('c22yzugqw77sv0wn5dq6xyz')
=> "POINT(-122.35 47.62)"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.1 + 0.2, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0.3, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.1 + 0.2, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0.3, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-14, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(5e-14, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 1e-14))
=> "0.6118465137198129"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-14, 0), 0)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-11, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-10, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-9, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-8, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-7, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-6, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-5, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-11, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-10, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-9, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-8, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-7, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-6, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-5, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1e-9))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), ST_GEOGPOINT(10 + 1e-9, 20))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(-1e-10, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-10, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-9, 0))
=> "1.1119510117748395E-4"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-9, 0))
=> "POINT(1e-09 0)"

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-9, 0))
=> "1.0E-9"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-13, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-12, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-13, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-12, 0))
=> null

=> "true"

=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(5e-12, 0))
=> "true"

=> "true"

=> "true"

=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(6e-12, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 60), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-11, 60))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 5e-12))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 6e-12))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(4e-12, 4e-12))
=> "true"

# The same point is within a micrometer, 8.9932e-12 degrees on the equator.

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(8.9e-12, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(9.1e-12, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(8.99e-12, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(9e-12, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(8.9e-12, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(9.1e-12, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 60), ST_GEOGPOINT(1.7e-11, 60))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 60), ST_GEOGPOINT(1.9e-11, 60))
=> "false"
